classical_method.description: finite-difference regularized Gauss-Newton on the five public terminal MEE residuals, with trust-region steps and projection onto the analytic all-longitude thrust bound

limitations: Stored local controls demonstrate public-input solvability, not runtime generalization or global optimality.
The six deterministic public missions require future server-held procedural instances.
The simulator omits third bodies, drag, eclipse, power, thermal and attitude constraints.
Engineering claims require independent mission-tool and domain-expert replication.
